summary: The Engineer fights through ONE robot, and every bot summon reads Matter Creation and Time & Space at the SAME value. So gear is judged on a single question: does it raise MC and TS together? After that come the things that keep the Engineer alive without a self-heal (ACs, Max Health, Nano Resist, reflect/absorb), the Max Nano / Nano Pool / nano-cost that let it re-summon and re-aura, the Max NCU to hold the buff stack, and the nine trade skills it is the game's best profession at (Mech.E, Elec.E, Quantum FT, Weapon Smithing and Tutoring are all cost factor 1.0). Pistol (1.5) and Grenade (2.0) are its own weapon skills and worth a slot or two, but the Engineer's damage is the bot. Every armour piece, requirement, bonus and profession lock below was read out of the client item pack, not from a guide. Bots are in engineer-pets.json, implants in engineer-implants.json, symbiants (Control line) in engineer-symbiants.json and weapons in engineer-weapons.json - they are deliberately NOT repeated here.

dataSources.itemTemplates: E:/Funcom/OmniCell/OmniCell/Datafiles/items.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, 120,842 templates, client 18.8.50_EP1), read with tools/eng-gear-extractor --prof 3 --wield. That run returned 68,637 wearable templates of which 61,510 are usable by profession 3 and 132 models are hard-locked to Profession EqualTo 3 (Engineer only).

dataSources.expansionGate: ToWear stat 389 (Expansion) BitAnd: bit 2 = Shadowlands, bit 8 = Alien Invasion, bit 32 = Lost Eden, bit 128 = Legacy of the Xan.
dataSources.sideAndBreedGates: ToWear stat 33 (Side) EqualTo: 1 = Clan, 2 = Omni - what separates the Chosen (Omni) and Faithful (Clan) suits. ToWear stat 4 (Breed) EqualTo 3 = NANOMAGE ONLY - this catches De'Valos Sleeves, which is easy to miss.

armorSets.note: Note how differently this reads from the Soldier's Ofab set: where the Soldier's gloves give Assault Rifle/Full Auto/MG-SMG, the Engineer's give Chemistry +35 and Pistol +23, and the boots give Elec.E +40 and Quantum FT +40. Funcom built the Engineer set around the tradeskill half of the class. The helmet is the important combat piece - Nano C. Init +60 and Space Time +16.

pieces.name: OFAB Engineer Protective Gear

pieces.name: Special Edition Ofab Engineer Helmet

Init (+100 vs +60) and adds Nano Resist +25, Add All Def. +25 and Critical Resistance +3, but it drops the Intelligence +20 and Space Time +16 that the normal helmet carries. For an Engineer chasing MC/TS that trade is NOT automatic - read both before buying.

armorSets.name: Combined Officer's Armor

keyBonuses.AllSixNanoSchools: +30 each - Matter Creation, Time & Space, Matter Metamorphosis, Bio Metamorphosis, Psychological Modification, Sensory Improvement
keyBonuses.NineTradeSkills: Mech.E, Elec.E, Quantum FT, Weapon Smithing, Pharma Tech, Nano Programming, Psychology, Chemistry +30 each

armorSets.levelRange: Endgame (Alien Invasion). QL300 pieces require Intelligence 1000, Psychic 1000 and Title Level 6 (level 190+).
armorSets.source: Tradeskilled from Arithmetic + Spiritual alien armour farmed in alien city raids, the sectors and mothership missions (wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Alien_Armor). The Arithmetic piece must be at least 80% of the Spiritual piece's QL and the result takes the higher QL.
armorSets.professionLock: none - Combined armour carries no Profession EqualTo clause. What makes this the Engineer's set is the stat spread.
armorSets.note: THE Engineer endgame set. Matter Creation +30 and Time & Space +30 on seven slots is +210 to both bot skills from armour alone, and the Engineer is also the profession that builds it - for itself and for everyone else. The Max Nano, Nano Pool and -3% nano cost matter because re-summoning a bot and re-casting an aura is expensive.

pieces.name: Blackmane's Combined Officer's Headwear
pieces.note: QL300 only; requires character level 210+ instead of Title Level 6. Same stat block.

armorSets.name: Combined Scout's Armor

keyBonuses.Initiatives: Melee Init, Ranged Init, Physical Init +40 each

armorSets.levelRange: Endgame (Alien Invasion). QL300 requires Intelligence 1000, Sense 1000 and Title Level 6.
armorSets.source: Tradeskilled from Arithmetic + Observant alien armour (wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Alien_Armor).
armorSets.note: The under-rated alternative for an Engineer: it keeps ALL of Officer's nano schools and trade skills and swaps Max Nano / Nano Pool / -3% cost for +40 to all three initiatives, +30 to all three evades, Perception, Concealment, Breaking & Entry and Trap Disarm. Evade-ClsC costs 4.0 and Dodge-Rng 2.5 for an Engineer (engineer-build.json calls close-combat evades 'effectively unaffordable'), so +30 to each from armour is worth more to this class than to most. Ability requirement is Intelligence/Sense instead of Intelligence/Psychic - check which your breed reaches.

_unverified: Azure Reveries: the item data proves QL200, Stamina 605, level 175, mostly NODROP + Unique. Its SOURCE (drop, quest or tradeskill) was not established.
Miy's Nano Armor drop camps: the family is known to drop from Medusae-type mobs, but the specific camps were not confirmed on a page for this file.

Spirit Tech Circlet of Yadmaron, Hood of Black Waters, Phatmos' Booty, Apprehensive Spirit Pitcher, Ring of Crawling Ants, Breastplate/Helmet of Technical Ceremonies and the Jobe Engineer Support System are all proven Engineer-only with exact requirements and bonuses from items.ocp, but WHERE each one comes from was not established.
Mechanical Analyzer (164548): confirmed Engineer-only and QL40 in the data; its stat block was not summarised because it is negligible.

Ofab upgrade economics ('Ofab -> Improved -> Penultimate with Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clumps, each clump at least 80% of the item QL') is carried from soldier-endgame.json, which cites wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Ofab_Armor_Upgrades. Not independently re-read for this file.
Bonus numbers are the TOP-QL template of each model; mid-QL values scale but the exact curve is not recorded here.

The two ids listed per Ofab/Tier/Miy's piece (e.g. 264575 and 264576) are two templates of the same model in items.ocp - the low-QL and high-QL ends of the range. Which one a vendor or drop hands you was not determined.

The claim that the Special Edition Ofab Engineer Helmet is NOT an automatic upgrade is a read of the two stat blocks side by side (it gains ACs / Health / Nano C. Init / Nano Resist / Add All Def. / Crit Resist, it loses Intelligence +20 and Space Time +16). Whether the net effect is better depends on how close you are to the next bot's MC/TS requirement - that judgement is not a fact from the data.

This file does NOT claim to be the exhaustive Engineer-equippable catalogue required by CLASS-PROFILE-PLAYBOOK section 9. It is the curated best-in-slot/progression layer over 61,510 Engineer-usable wearable templates and 132 Engineer-locked models. A partial exhaustive catalogue was generated into the scratch area by an earlier pass but was never written to a profile file.
